home_route.new_intent: l1.y3(Intent) stores intent then invokes I3
home_route.startup_callback: com.twitter.app.main.x0.a(Object): either H3(HomeUri) directly or I3(captured launch Intent). Confirmed x0 created by l1 startup.
home_route.configuration: com.twitter.app.main.n0 constructor also reads b.d() explicit page for initial tab config.

remembered_tab.warning: Do not delete shared preferences or database; app-native explicit page bypass exists.

resources.home_id: 0x7f0b08ec exists, but not proven to be bottom-nav Home button; do not rely on it alone

recommendation.startup: Prefer launcher-only injection of explicit page=twitter://timeline/home before presenter reads intent; preserve external deep links/notifications. Runtime integration and physical verification are parent responsibilities.
recommendation.terminal: Retain native child/modal handling and intercept only terminal platform fallback or p.d exact MainActivity path.
